gizmo.title: H5P
gizmo.description: Hoʻokani i ka maʻamau launa pāpā H5P mai kahi waihona .h5p i hoʻouka ʻia, me ka makemake ʻole i kahi kikowaena H5P

advanced.title: Ke kumu iframe kahiko
advanced.description: No ka maʻamau kahiko wale nō e hoʻokomo ana i kahi iframe H5P mai kahi pūnaewele ʻē. E waiho i ka hakahaka inā ua hoʻonohonoho ʻia kahi waihona .h5p ma luna.
E hoʻouka a loulou paha i kahi waihona .h5p. Wehe ʻia ia i loko o ka polokalamu kele; ʻaʻole pono kahi kikowaena H5P.
advanced.title: Waihona H5P
